title: TikTok Shop Setup: Step-by-Step Guide for Seller Center and App Launch
summary: Master your TikTok Shop setup. Follow our step-by-step guide to register in Seller Center, configure the mobile app, and launch compliant product listings.
body_markdown:
## Step-by-Step Seller Center Registration and Account Linking


Once your records are ready, register through the official TikTok Shop Seller Center rather than a third-party login page. A tiktok shop seller account should be built around one consistent business or individual identity, with access controlled by the appropriate account owner. Save your sign-in method securely and confirm that you can reach the dashboard before configuring connected TikTok profiles. The official TikTok Shop Seller Center registration guidance describes the setup flow; follow its current prompts, since available options can change.


### Desktop Registration via business.tiktokshop.com


On desktop, start at the official Seller Center entry point and select the US marketplace where applicable. Complete the requested email or phone verification, choose the seller type, enter business or individual details, and upload requested proof. Review every field against your documents before submitting. Use the dashboard to check account status and follow-up requests, whether approval is complete or review is underway. Keep a record of the login email, application details, and verification notices for your operations team.


1. Open the official Seller Center and begin seller registration.
2. Verify the contact method and select the correct seller profile.
3. Enter legal, tax, and identity details exactly as documented.
4. Upload clear files, submit the application, then monitor its status.


### Mobile App Setup and Push Notification Configuration


After creating your account, install the official TikTok Shop seller app from your device’s app store and use the same credentials as your desktop login. Confirm the app name and publisher before entering account details. Allow notifications for verification updates, order or account alerts, and other operational messages you need to act on quickly. If the tiktok shop login fails, verify the email or phone used during registration, check for a verification prompt, and avoid repeatedly creating new accounts.


### Linking Your Official TikTok Account and Marketing Account


Seller Center distinguishes an official account, associated with the shop’s public identity, from marketing accounts that support promotion. Review the account-linking options in the dashboard and authorize only profiles your business controls. An official profile can represent the shop, while marketing profiles can support additional promotional activity, subject to current account rules. Linking a Shopify or Amazon store is not the same as linking a TikTok profile; check Seller Center’s available integrations and authorization steps rather than assuming an external storefront transfers automatically.


Account type Primary role Before linking


Official TikTok account Represents the shop’s public-facing identity. Confirm the profile is controlled by your business and reflects its brand.


Marketing account Supports promotional activity for the shop. Check account permissions and authorize the intended profile.


For campaign planning, the FastMoss TikTok Data Analytics Platform can help teams review creator and product signals after account access is established. Keep analytics access distinct from Seller Center permissions, and grant each teammate only the access their role requires. The FastMoss TikTok Data Analytics Platform is a separate analytics resource, not a substitute for seller verification or account linking.
